title: Uniqueness of low degree polynomial coefficients
statement:
For every $n,
\ell\in\mathbb{N}$, the map sending a coefficient assignment on subsets of $[n]$ of size at most $\ell$ to the Boolean function on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ obtained by summing its coefficients times the corresponding squarefree monomials is injective.
